optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Quality Analytics Specialist, Automotive Parts Plant

professionalSummary.text: Analyses inspection and scrap data and runs statistical process control charts for the critical characteristics.
professionalSummary.witness: Quality analytics specialist at a body components plant for four years, analysing the plant's inspection and scrap data and running the statistical process control charts for the twenty-two critical characteristics on the two stamping lines.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares the monthly supplier quality report for the customers under the supplier quality agreements.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly supplier quality report for the plant's two customers under their supplier quality agreements, with the reports accepted by both customers' supplier quality engineers each month.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Investigates capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Investigated capability drops with the line supervisors under the plant's investigation procedure, running the measurement studies with the metrology lab; the corrective actions were approved by the plant quality manager.

skills.text: Coordinates corrective action data with the plant quality manager and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Provided the corrective action data to the plant quality manager for each investigation, recording in the investigation file which analyses were mine and which belonged to the supervisors.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in analysing inspection and scrap data, preparing supplier quality reports, investigating capability drops, and recording responsibility boundaries. They do not establish the candidate's ability to document each investigation's limitations and hand-over conditions.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and work samples align with the role's requirements, but further human review is required to assess the completeness of the evidence and to make a final decision.
